statement: Seed bootstrap must release its distinct eligible partition cohorts within the existing one shared original deadline, while completing sql_transactions control first and preserving each independent partition cutover's current full membership, control-owner pre/post validation and complete pause/enable/observe/final census/resume protocol. A bounded concurrency owner may submit distinct cohorts together; concurrent nested control RELEASE requests must join the canonical single RUNS owner, never cache control permission.

constraints.statement: This is the explicit successor to the seed-release-once-per-partition-cohort serialization constraint ONLY for concurrently executing independent partition IDs. Preserve the complete input-sorted one-intent-per-partition list, SQL_TRANSACTIONS as a hard successful predecessor, original authorizations, authentic existing member cohorts, and all current control pre/post release checks. A single partition never has concurrent seed release intents. No new permission cache, second coordinator, status reader, leader shortcut, or relaxed OPEN guard.

Use one seed workflow owner for bounded independent partition concurrency with an immutable, conservatively small cap. No detached tasks, fire-and-forget dispatch, unobserved Promise rejection, or mutable global batch state. On any refusal the owner must join every already-started task before throwing a deterministic first-by-input-order failure. Do not send additional work after detecting failure, including while settling already-started tasks; source must prove this.

Use the ONE existing timeSource and absolute shared 1000/5000ms deadline, no per-cohort renewal or timeout increases. Maintain sorted deterministic launch order and a stable, first-by-input-order error projection even when sibling promises finish out of order. Each existing request retains its original retry policy and observably typed answer.

Concurrency is allowed only across distinct Raft partition groups after full current SQL_TRANSACTIONS cutover succeeds. The canonical replica-handler RUNS owner coalesces concurrent nested control releases with matching build; it alone validates current control authority, real generation and actual member census before/after each dependent cutover. A failed control owner must block dependent release, never grant permission by prior success.

Measure named engaged red on serial source using the exact same orchestration test. Test maximum in-flight, control-first barrier, ordinal and completion-failure preservation, retry failure with all started in-flight settled, no new task after refusal and no fake activation. Independently prove real source on same physical host against original 1000ms claim/cache and 5000ms bootstrap full body, plus exact source controls, native V10, TX1/TX2, FreshMG, restart, seed-loss and zero-Liferaft gates.

Original 1000ms test is currently red despite one intent per cohort: exact hosted trace reports 514 completed deliveries, of which 347 control, with 21 complete control RELEASE calls for 10 non-control partitions, all trace drops/errors zero. No ratchet/budget increase, skipped body, fixture shadow, or recovery state forgery counts as success; source-only and hosted evidence are WIP until independent review and locked host acceptance.
